checks.compiled_query:
CALL {
  CALL db.labels() YIELD label
  RETURN collect(label) AS _gc_labels
}
CALL {
  CALL db.relationshipTypes() YIELD relationshipType
  RETURN collect(relationshipType) AS _gc_rel_types
}

        CALL {
          MATCH (n:`Account`)
          WHERE n.`balance` IS NOT NULL
          RETURN count(n) AS population,
                 sum(CASE WHEN NOT (coalesce(
  CASE $expected_type
    WHEN 'string' THEN toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
    WHEN 'integer' THEN
      toIntegerOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
      AND toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) =~ '^-?[0-9]+$'
    WHEN 'float' THEN
      toFloatOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
      AND NOT (
        toIntegerOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
        AND toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) =
          toStringOrNull(toIntegerOrNull(n.`balance`))
      )
    WHEN 'boolean' THEN toBooleanOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
    WHEN 'date' THEN
      NOT (toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`)
      AND toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) =~ '^-?[0-9]{4,}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    WHEN 'datetime' THEN
      NOT (toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`)
      AND toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) =~ '^-?[0-9]{4,}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T.*$'
    ELSE false
  END,
  false
)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violation_count
        }
        RETURN 
all(name IN $required_labels WHERE name IN _gc_labels)
  AND all(name IN $required_relationship_types WHERE name IN _gc_rel_types) AS schema_ok,
[name IN $required_labels WHERE NOT name IN _gc_labels] AS missing_labels,
[name IN $required_relationship_types WHERE NOT name IN _gc_rel_types]
  AS missing_relationship_types
,
               population, violation_count, [] AS evidence
